title: Importing DXF and PDF
content:
Hello, I am trying to import a DXF from Gerber as aama. At first I thought it opened well and I had in the pattern a reference box that's 10*10 cm it opened the right size. However, when I checked the pattern pieces themselves they had a difference of 1 cm in each piece that's less than the original pattern. 

Also another option I tried was importing a pdf from illustrator, but it always opens with a bounding box that I can't get rid of. 

So would appreciate any tips on importing DXFs of PDFs from either programs.

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi There!For exporting from Gerber, did you check to make sure the export size settings were correct. Then also check the size settings when importing to CLO.For Illustrator before you finish in Ai did you make sure each pattern piece is a closed shape? This means the points must be connected, not just overlapping. Also, when importing to you go to File > Import < Adobe?
content_description: This webpage aims to provide guidance and tips for successfully importing DXF and PDF files from Gerber and Illustrator, addressing common issues such as size discrepancies and unwanted bounding boxes.

title: CLO 2025.0 is officially here!
content:
![49508ce1f9bf43c9a5823473964c49b3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6ba374550f414138a8d1585cab3839b4/images/49508ce1f9bf43c9a5823473964c49b3release25_scoop_en.png)

CLO 2025.0 has added 42 new features, making CLO even more powerful than our previous versions.  


**CLO 2025.0 Highlight Features:**

  


  * **Key Frame Animation:** Elevate animations by applying keyframes to various components, creating dynamic and sophisticated visuals.

  * **Pattern Drafter:** Create and edit accurate parametric patterns with minimal measurements. Additionally, instantly generate them from a schematic sketch image.

  * **AI Pose Generator:** Effortlessly create avatar poses using keywords or an image.

  * **Avatar IK Joint Mapping:** Streamline IK joint mapping for various avatars to achieve natural movement while ensuring seamless compatibility for motions and poses across all avatars.

  * **Avatar Hip Shape:** Create a variety of hip shapes with hip dip and upper volume customization.

  * **Texture-Based Nesting:** Optimize pattern placement with minimal waste, while maintaining texture and prints.

  * **Advanced Pinching:** Express more realistic wrinkles and shapes with precise pinching, just like pulling real fabric.

  * **GPU Rendering on macOS:** Unlock faster, more efficient rendering performance with GPU rendering on macOS.

  * **Fur Generation:** Generate various types of fur in real-time, with compatibility across multiple platforms.




Discover even more features of 2025.0 right [_HERE_](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features) and [_DOWNLOAD_](https://clo3d.com/en/clo/download) it today.

title: 클로 패턴에서의 dxf 와 유카캐드 프로그램에서의 호환성
content:
clo로 패턴작업을 하여 dxf로 내보내 yuka 프로그램으로 옮겨 작업을 해야하는데

항상 dxf파일로 내보낼때 유카 프로그램과의 호환성 문제가 있습니다.

테스트를 항상 해보지만 해결이 안되는건 기초선 문제, 주석 및 클로 파일 제목(패턴명 오류)

클로에서 dxf 파일로 저장을 했을때 패턴이 2장으로 겹쳐짐의 문제가 정말 문제가 있다고 생각합니다. (이 부분의 문제는 유카와의 호환성의 문제가 아닌 클로 자체적인 버그 같습니다.)

클로에서 dxf로 내보내고 다시 클로 프로그램에서 저장한 dxf 파일을 열었을때 2장으로 겹쳐진 파일을 확인 할 수 있습니다. 저는 맥북으로 작업을 하고 있습니다.

저는 단지 클로를 3d프로그램만이 아닌 실물로 만들고 생산까지 하는 프로그래머이기 때문에 이런 부문에 있어서는 일을 두번하지 않게 버그를 clo에서 고쳐주셨으면 하는 바람입니다. (시급함.)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: 안녕하세요. 질문해 주셔서 감사합니다. 귀하의 계정에 연결된 CLO 라이선스가 없는 것 같습니다. 활성 CL0 라이선스에 연결된 CL0 ID가 무엇인지 알려주시겠습니까?

title: Fabrics colliding with each other
content:
Hi, so this has been a problem of mine quite a while  
When I want to layer garments, it seems that the fabric of the shirts 'clash' with fabric of the jacket. making both garments unstable and moving frantically.

I have tried layering, freezing the garments, but it all the same. can anyone help me?

![d06177d3b28146c1ac843f6499a8e83c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6fc614ccfbb94ad4bd5fc84927c96f27/images/d06177d3b28146c1ac843f6499a8e83cScreenshot%202025-04-11%20140019.png)

![075f8bd5c4a74c9aa00a67d83aa9b9d9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/6fc614ccfbb94ad4bd5fc84927c96f27/images/075f8bd5c4a74c9aa00a67d83aa9b9d9Screenshot%202025-04-11%20140033.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: This is an issue with the fabric not fitting under the arm pit. The T-pose helps while creating the outfit but doesn’t help when you have to move everything to the final pose so what I do is lower the avatar skin offset. It’s set to 3mm as default. Lower this to 1mm. Then for the fabric offset lower this also. This will allow more fabric is a tighter space under the arm. If this doesn’t fix it I sometimes decrease the bicep circumference or nudge the shoulders out a little.

Comment 2: Hi, I would advise to work with the avatar's default T-pose first when building and sewing your garments. In your screenshots, the arms are too close with the body, which is why the fabrics are colliding with each other and the avatar.
content_description: Get expert tips and solutions for overcoming common layering challenges and achieving a stylish, stable outfit.

title: Animation Export Issue (ABC, FBX)
content:
I'm trying to apply one of CLO’s default motion files to the default female avatar and export it to work in another program (like Blender or C4D). I exported the avatar as an FBX file, but no matter which motion file I apply in CLO, the animation only imports up to frame 26 in both Blender and C4D.

If I export as an ABC (Alembic) file, the full animation plays correctly in both programs — but since Alembic files don’t carry UV data, it creates problems with texturing. That’s why I would prefer to export using FBX.

I remember FBX exports working fine in the past, but now it seems like something has changed. Is this a known issue?

I've attached screenshots of my FBX export settings in CLO and the import settings in Blender. The motion file I applied has a total of **577 frames** , but again, only **26 frames** are imported into Blender and C4D. I’ve also confirmed that the **Scene Time Warp** in CLO is properly set to **1** , so that shouldn’t be causing the issue.

Is there currently a bug or known issue preventing full animation export through FBX?  
Or is it inherently difficult to export full motion via FBX from CLO, and ABC is the only reliable option?

Is there any way to fix this?

I’d really appreciate any solution or workaround.

my CLO3D version : 2024.2.344
